newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells two discount T-bill issues Monday.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells two discount T-bill issues Monday.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry on Monday sold two discount T-bill issues with maturities of one week and four weeks, yielding 3.59 percent and 17.36 percent respectively, the central bank said.
Bids were received for a total of 17.505 billion levs of paper but the ministry approved bids for 14.005 billion levs worth.
The ministry has offered the issues with no par value set in advance after it decided last week to issue seven-day T-bills every day to regulate excessive banks' liquidity.

As a result of the ministry's decision the central bank said on Thursday that it would suspend from Monday its daily open market operations through the revrepo facility with repurchase of up to two days.
The decisions were connected with preparations for the implementation of a currency board system under which central bank open market operations would be curbed.
